variants.description: Untyped parameter with [] default — no type annotation, same shared-list mistake.
Same mutable list default in a brand-new module src/reports.py.
Untyped dict default store={} — no type annotation on the parameter.
Module-level list assigned to _DEFAULT_EVENTS then used as parameter default — same shared object, reached via a named variable.
list() constructor call used as default instead of [] literal — still evaluated once at definition time, same shared object.
set() constructor call used as default — mutable set shared across all calls, same root cause.
